pit_knowledge_column: date (daily bar, public at close); |prc| convention: negative = bid/ask midpoint on no-trade days; vol in SHARES on dsf (not hundreds — that is msf)
sql_note: SELECT permno, date, prc, ret, retx, vol, shrout, askhi, bidlo, openprc, cfacpr, cfacshr FROM crsp.dsf WHERE permno = ANY(%(p)s) AND date BETWEEN %(s)s AND %(e)s
